item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00389","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C20","C19","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C20","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C20 is expressly invoked and closely reused in the child. The child repeats C20's direction that Federal agencies review their programs and modify them wherever practicable to reduce competition with defense needs, then applies that general review framework to Federal-aid highway construction. C20 also specifically identifies civil public works and grant-in-aid programs for deferral, curtailment, or slowing, making it a concrete administrative and drafting template rather than merely a document on the same broad topic. C19 shares the defense-materials rationale and program-curtailment approach, while C02 shares the Korean-emergency legislative context, but neither matches C20's language and machinery as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have already directed the Federal agencies to review their programs for the purpose of modifying them wherever practicable to lessen demands for supplies and services in competition with defense needs.","parent_excerpt":"I announced that I was directing the executive agencies \"--to conduct a detailed review of Government programs, for the purpose of modifying them wherever practicable to lessen the demand upon services, commodities, raw materials, manpower, and facilities which are in competition with those needed for national defense.\"","explanation":"The child closely reproduces C20's distinctive review-and-modification directive and explicitly refers back to that prior action."},{"child_excerpt":"One of the programs under review is Federal aid for highway construction. This is one of our major activities in the field of civil public works.","parent_excerpt":"All civil public works, both direct Federal programs and grant-in-aid programs, should be screened with the objective, as far as practical, deferring, curtailing, or slowing down those projects which do not directly contribute to defense or to civilian requirements essential in the changed international situation","explanation":"The child applies C20's specific screening machinery for civil public works and grant-in-aid programs to the Federal-aid highway bill."},{"child_excerpt":"In view of our increased defense requirements... H.R. 7941 seems inconsistent with the effort to hold down non-defense spending.","parent_excerpt":"The Government, as well as the public, must exercise great restraint in the use of those goods and services which are needed for our increased defense efforts.","explanation":"Both documents use the changed defense situation as the operative reason to restrain nondefense government programs."}]}
